summary: Iter 265 — US readiness for independent Partner Engineers. Tested both backend (multipart apply with country_code, approval propagation, compliance doc set, USD price selection, GB regression) and frontend (5-country picker with data-testid='pe-apply-country', reactive postcode label/placeholder). All checks pass; no regressions in the GB flow.

issues: React hydration warning: visual-editor wraps option labels in a <span> inside <option> (`<span> option cannot be a child of`). Cosmetic devtools-only — the select still renders all 5 countries and select_option('US') works. Affects every option label across the app, not specific to iter 265.
Console: CSP blocks emergent-main.js, posthog, cloudflare beacon, and two `/api/...` 401s on the marketing shell. Pre-existing infrastructure noise, not iter 265.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/partners.py is 5297 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Splitting (e.g., applications.py, compliance.py, checkout.py) would make iterations like 265 less risky. Not blocking this ticket.

_validate_postcode (partners.py:197) is GB-only by design but only enforces length≤12 + non-empty — accepts '10001' for GB. Spec called this out as expected for non-GB; for GB you may want a stricter UK postcode regex if false-positive ZIPs matter. Current behaviour matches existing tests so not regressed.
Visual-editor wrappers inserting <span> inside <option> trigger a React hydration warning on this page. App-wide artifact; consider an editor escape on <option> children.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (country picker, 5 options, reactive ZIP label + placeholder, GB↔US toggle)
